items.title: Charles Elgar Interview, 1958-05-27
items.q: Well, we had Donald Howard, clarinet and violin. Joe Sutler on trumpet.

ctx.x: I haven't heard those for several years now because I hardly ever play 78 records, but I did pick those up years ago. Who were some of the outstanding musicians in that orchestra at that time?
Well, we had Donald Howard, clarinet and violin. Joe Sutler on trumpet. We had Will, so memory doesn't function too much.
